title: Origin story: Shango
description: Shango was the fourth king of Oyo, a mighty warrior-king who hanged himself after his own magic destroyed his palace — then ascended as the orisha of thunder and lightning. His worshippers say he did not die but became the storm, and his double-axe, the oshe, strikes the unjust.

title: Ability profile: Shango
description: Ranked abilities: Thunder command — rank 100/100; War — rank 97/100; Kingship — rank 96/100; Dance — rank 95/100; Justice — rank 93/100.

title: Power ranking: Shango
description: Powers: Lightning as his personal weapon; The double-headed oshe axe; Fire that purifies and punishes.

title: Stamina feats: Shango
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Ruled and warred without rest; Thunders across the world to this day.

title: Crossover notes: Shango
description: Shango crosses naturally with: thunder, fire, justice, kingship, dance.

title: Cultural impact: Shango
description: Worshipped across the Yoruba diaspora; thunder as justice.
